newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia TCorp 2008 bond yields 8.244 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia TCorp 2008 bond yields 8.244 pct.

text.p: New South Wales Treasury Corp (TCorp) said on Tuesday its tender of its new 8.0 percent March 2008 stock produced an weighted average yield (WAY) of 8.244 percent.
TCorp said A$360 million had been allotted compared with the A$300 million originally offered.
OFFERED A$300 MLN COUPON 8.0 PCT MATURITY 01.03.08
ALLOTTED A$360 MLN WAY 8.244 SETT DATE 21.03.97

TCorp, the central borrowing authority for the state of New South Wales, added that to build-up this new benchmark stock it would be looking to consolidate out of its 2001, 2004 and 2006 stocks from 11.00 a.m. (0000 GMT).
TCorp said on Monday that it would be looking for an additional A$200 million over the A$300 million originally offered at tender, either through oversubscription or through consolidation.
